cohort: Pregnant patients of any age undergoing emergency or elective obstetrics or gynecological procedures between January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2020, at a tertiary care hospital in the UAE.
finding: The incidence of unexpected return to the operation theater after obstetrics or gynecological surgery was 0.15%, with bleeding being the most common indication and lower segment cesarean section the most common primary operation.
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean section was the most common primary operation for which re-exploration was done (33.3%).
